children: ST. PAUL (dpa-AFX) - The Travelers Companies  Inc. (TRV) announced a profit for its third quarter that Increases, from the same period last year
The company's earnings came in at $1.917 billion, or $9.04 per share.  This compares with $1.888 billion, or $8.24 per share, last year.
Excluding items, The Travelers Companies  Inc. reported adjusted earnings of $1.947 billion or $9.18 per share for the period.
The company's revenue for the period fell 0.5% to $12.412 billion from $12.470 billion last year.
